title: saussurea candolleana
intro: Saussurea candolleana, commonly known as Himalayan Costus or Himalayan Saussurea, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Saussurea candolleana include reducing inflammation and modulating the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
